description: Live request manifest for the MOTIF Qloo feasibility spike (MOTIF_QLOO_FEASIBILITY.md rev 0.2, section 8). Seeds are inputs, not Qloo IDs. Entity types are the harness 0.1.26 type list; their availability under the event credential is not verified until a live run.

seeds.note: Film studio/distributor. Its Qloo type is unknown; the expected type only breaks ties between same-name candidates.
Fashion label. Name comparison folds case and accents (ç = c); nothing fuzzier.
Brand name shared with non-brand entities is possible; ambiguity is reported, not guessed.
Brand and person share the name; the expected type narrows only exact-name candidates.

resolution_overrides_help: Only after reviewing an ambiguous search: {"<seed key>": {"qloo_id": "<an ID the search actually returned>", "reason": "..."}}. An ID that was not returned is rejected.

pilot.description: Two contrasting seeds, three domains. Inspect output before expanding.

full.description: All five seeds and all six candidate domains. Identical successful pilot requests are reused, not re-sent.
